sanskrit_verse:
प्रव्रज्यावसितो राज्ञो दास आमरणान्तिकम् ।
वर्णानामानुलोम्येन दास्यं न प्रतिलोमतः ॥१८३॥
transliteration: pravrajyāvasito rājño dāsa āmaraṇāntikam | varṇānām ānulomyena dāsyaṃ na pratilomataḥ || 183 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has renounced royal life and taken shelter in asceticism becomes a servant until death; servitude arises only through natural hierarchical flow among varnas, never against it.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from spiritual renunciation, not political assertion
Causation of servitude is rooted in conscious choice and dharmic alignment
Capacity-based responsibility originates in individual volition toward sannyasa
Restoration logic centers on realigning social roles according to cosmic hierarchy
Consciousness alignment determines the legitimacy of relational structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual formally renounces royal or ruling status AND enters ascetic life THEN assign societal role of service UNTIL bodily dissolution
IF varna interaction results in subordination THEN permit only when aligned with natural order ELSE nullify transaction
IF claimant asserts dominance over higher varna THEN reject claim by default AND restore original status quo
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving former rulers seeking ascetic refuge, courts must recognize irrevocable transition into servile condition as valid under Dharma. Claims asserting reverse-varna dominance are ipso facto invalid and require immediate restoration of natural order without punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: By pramāṇa of declared intent and irreversible act of renunciation, causal chain establishes new relational framework. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential abandonment of power, wealth, and identity. Responsibility aligns with capacity retained post-renunciation. No suffering is mandated; reality itself enforces structural correction via loss of prior authority.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Formal documentation of renunciant's surrender of regal insignia and transfer of duties
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Initiation into guru-disciple lineage confirming acceptance into servant class
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ongoing assessment ensuring no residual claims to former position arise
Integrity Reintegration Procedure: Public ceremony affirming shift in social location and reaffirming natural hierarchy
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness reigns as sole adjudicator.
